paragraphs.en: Chimpanzees (（黑猩猩）) , the closest living relatives of {mankind} , exhibit {superior} intelligence that is comparable to many human {traits} .They can recall the {locations} of food sources even after a long period, demonstrating advanced memory and learning abilities.They have been observed using sticks to fish for termites (（白蚁）) or {honey} , which indicates a {primitive} grasp of technology, much like humans choosing the proper {equipment} for different purposes.They live in complex social groups and even engage in“ {political} ”activities, with some individuals {entitled} to power within their groups.
paragraphs.cn: 黑猩猩是现存与 <u> 人类 </u> 亲缘关系最近的亲属，它们展现出了可与人类许多 <u> 特质 </u> 相媲美的 <u> 卓越的 </u> 智力。即使过了很长时间，它们也能回忆起食物来源的 <u> 位置 </u> ，显示了高超的记忆和学习能力。人们观察到它们会用木棍取出白蚁或 <u> 蜂蜜 </u> ，这表明它们 <u> 初步 </u> 掌握了一些技能，类似于人类会根据不同目的选择合适的 <u> 工具 </u> 。它们生活在复杂的社会群体中，甚至会参与“ <u> 政治 </u> ”活动，群体内一些个体 <u> 拥有 </u> 权力。

paragraphs.en: Sounds are the main {mode} of communication for chimpanzees.For example, some of their calls mean“ {hello} ”or a greeting, while a {sudden} sharp {scream} {warns} others of the presence of danger.Recently, researchers say they have translated the {concrete} meaning of {gestures} that wild chimpanzees use to communicate.They say wild chimps communicate with a“ {vocabulary} ”of 66 gestures.The most common gesture is the hand slap, often used in displays of aggression, similar to a human {strike} .A chimpanzee may also {bend} its body in a gesture of conciliation (（和解）) , similar to how humans might {bow} to show respect.The scientists discovered this by {filming} groups of chimps in Uganda, and examining more than 5,000 {incidents} of these meaningful exchanges.
paragraphs.cn: 声音是黑猩猩的主要交流 <u> 方式 </u> 。例如，它们的一些叫声表示“ <u> 你好 </u> ”或问候，而 <u> 突然 </u> 的尖锐 <u> 叫声 </u> 则是在 <u> 警告 </u> 其他黑猩猩有危险。最近，研究人员称他们已经破译了野生黑猩猩用于交流的 <u> 手势 </u> 的 <u> 具体 </u> 含义。他们说，野生黑猩猩用66种手势“ <u> 词汇 </u> ”进行交流。最常见的手势是用手拍打，常用于表现攻击性，类似于人类的 <u> 击打 </u> 动作。一只黑猩猩也可能 <u> 弯下 </u> 身体，做出一种表示和解意图的姿势，类似于人类用 <u> 鞠躬 </u> 来表示尊重。科学家们通过对乌干达的几个黑猩猩群进行 <u> 拍摄 </u> ，并研究了5000多例此类有意义的交流 <u> 事件 </u> 才发现了这一点。

paragraphs.en: Dr.Catherine Hobaiter, who led the research, said that this was the only form of {intentional} communication to be recorded in the animal {kingdom} .Only humans and chimps, she said, had a system of communication where they {deliberately} sent a message to another group member.“The gestures are the only thing that looks like human language in that respect.”
paragraphs.cn: 主导这项研究的凯瑟琳·霍拜特博士表示，这是动物 <u> 界 </u> 被记录下来的唯一 <u> 有意的 </u> 交流方式。她说，只有人类和黑猩猩拥有这样的交流系统，在这个系统中，它们会 <u> 有意识地 </u> 向群体中的其他成员传递信息。“从这个方面来看，这些手势是唯一类似于人类语言的东西。”

paragraphs.en: Although {previous} research has shown that some primates can understand complex information from another animal's call, neither {apes} {nor} monkeys {appear} to use their voices intentionally to communicate messages.This was a significant difference between calls and gestures, Dr.Hobaiter said.
paragraphs.cn: 尽管 <u> 以前的 </u> 研究表明，一些灵长类动物可以通过其他个体的叫声理解复杂的信息，但无论是 <u> 猿还是 </u> 猴， <u> 似乎 </u> 都不能有意地使用声音来传递信息。霍拜特博士说，这是叫声与手势之间的一个重要区别。

paragraphs.en: In one case, a mother presents her foot to her crying baby, {signaling} :“Climb on me.”The {youngster} immediately jumps onto its mother's back and they travel off together.
paragraphs.cn: 在一个例子中，一只母猩猩把自己的脚伸到正在啼哭的幼崽面前，这一举动 <u> 示意 </u> ：“爬到我身上来。” <u> 小 </u> 猩猩立刻跳到了母亲背上，随后它们一同离开了。

paragraphs.en: Dr.Susanne Shultz, an {evolutionary} {biologist} from the University of Manchester, said the study was {worthwhile} in seeking to {enrich} our knowledge of the {evolution} of human language.But, she added, the results were “a little {disappointing} ”.
paragraphs.cn: 来自曼彻斯特大学的 <u> 进化生物学家 </u> 苏珊娜·舒尔茨博士表示，这项研究在 <u> 丰富 </u> 我们对人类语言 <u> 演化 </u> 的认识方面很 <u> 有价值 </u> 。但她补充说，研究结果“有点 <u> 令人失望 </u> ”。

paragraphs.en: “The {vagueness} of the gesture meanings suggests either that chimps have little to communicate, or that we are still missing a lot of the information contained in their gestures and actions,”she said.“ {Moreover} , the meanings seem not to go beyond what other animals {convey} with {non-verbal} communication.So, it seems the {gulf} remains.”
paragraphs.cn: 她说：“手势含义的 <u> 模糊性 </u> 表明，要么黑猩猩没有什么可交流的内容，要么我们仍然遗漏了这些手势和动作中包含的大量信息。 <u> 此外 </u> ，这些含义似乎并没有超出其他动物通过 <u> 非语言 </u> 交流所 <u> 传达 </u> 的内容。因此， <u> 差距 </u> 似乎依然存在。” 5NoOncib/NjiX02BpMIzP4m+378Hw1xTRxUdPaP/PFjKUFq4K2G7tp6ZLYoCE601yW1W39VMdLmovFdSHs4nVQ==
